content.text:
Variable loans had the higher CPR in three of the four quarters of 2024. Fixed loans were higher only in Q3.

- **Q1:** fixed 13.26%, variable 17.32%.
- **Q2:** fixed 9.46%, variable 17.54%.
- **Q3:** fixed 17.98%, variable 17.48%.
- **Q4:** fixed 11.06%, variable 17.55%.

Variable CPR stayed in a narrow band from 17.32% to 17.55%. Fixed CPR moved much more, from a low of 9.46% to a high of 17.98%.
